subject: Mid‑cycle feedback and next steps for Logan Wright
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle feedback and next steps

Hi Logan,

I've attached a short summary of where things stand at the mid‑cycle checkpoint (midcycle_feedback.pdf). In short: you've delivered on several feature tasks but we've seen repeated misses on SLAs for production incidents and several PR reviews have required rework for test coverage.

I want to set a clear, focused plan so you have the support and time to get back on track. Can we meet tomorrow at 3pm to walk through the document and agree on concrete next steps? Monica is CC'd so HR can advise on process and documentation.

High‑level asks for the meeting:
- Review the attached feedback (3–4 minutes).
- Agree 2–3 measurable goals for the next 30 days.
- Schedule weekly 30-minute check-ins.

If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives. This conversation is intended to be supportive; the goal is clarity and to avoid escalating to a formal PIP if we see improvement.

Thanks,
Ava

--
Ava Chen
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle feedback and next steps

Ava,

Thanks for the heads up and for looping HR in. A few quick process notes before the meeting:
- Please keep the language factual and attribute-specific (dates, examples, impact). Avoid subjective descriptors.
- Share the pre_pip_guidance.pdf with the employee in the meeting packet so they understand the steps and timelines.
- If the meeting results in a written action plan, keep copies in the HR case folder and mark the timeline (we typically use a 30‑day corrective period for this type of coaching before considering a formal PIP).
- I'll join if you'd like; otherwise I can be on standby and help with wording for any follow‑up emails.

I recommend noting the support we will offer (mentorship hours, pairing sessions, and clearer acceptance criteria) so it's not just a list of deficits. That will help with fairness and remediation.

I also attached the internal checklist (pre_pip_guidance.pdf) you can use.

—Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations Business Partner
HR, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle feedback and next steps — summary and 30-day plan

Hi Logan — thanks for making time today. Per our conversation, here is a concise summary and the agreed 30‑day action plan (attached: 30_day_action_plan.xlsx). Please treat this as the documented coaching track we discussed.

What we covered (examples included in the attached doc):
- Impact areas: incident response timelines (notably 07/21 outage where on‑call follow‑up was delayed), PR quality (insufficient unit tests on feature X), and ownership signals (missed regular syncs for component handoff).
- Measureable goals for next 30 days:
  1) Incident response: reduce mean response time for P0s on your pager to under 10 minutes for any new incidents (we'll track incident timestamps).
  2) PR quality: deliver two consecutive PRs with full unit test coverage and green CI on first run.
  3) Ownership: attend and contribute to the weekly infra syncs; lead the postmortem writeup for the next on‑call rotation.
- Support we'll provide: 4 hours/week of focused pairing with Marcus (senior backend), weekly 30‑minute one‑on‑ones with me, and access to the testing checklist.
- Checkpoints: weekly written progress updates (email to me and Monica), and a review meeting at the 30‑day mark.

Next steps you agreed to:
- Reply to confirm you accept the plan and the measurements below.
- Add times for the recurring 30‑minute weekly check‑ins to your calendar (Ava proposed Fridays 10am PST).

Important: If the measurable goals are not met after 30 days, we will review with People Ops and discuss a formal PIP. The intent is remedial and transparent; we want to give you every reasonable opportunity to succeed.

Attachments: 30_day_action_plan.xlsx (action items, owners, dates), midcycle_feedback.pdf

Thanks,
Ava
